command_line.error.cannot_run.description: Notification: the program typed in the command line is not runnable. {program} is its name, e.g. "notes.txt".

command_line.error.not_found.description: Notification: the shell found no program by the name typed in the command line. {program} is that name, e.g. "gimp".

command_line.history.empty.description: The command line's drop-down list when no command was run yet.

command_line.on_server.description: Notification: a command typed in the command line does not run while the panel shows a server.
command_line.on_server.message: Commands run on this computer; the panel is on a server.

main.admin.button.description: Button: do it again as administrator; the system then asks for the password. Keep it short.

main.admin.deleting.description: What permission refused, before ": permission denied. As administrator, …": {count} files or folders left undeleted, e.g. 3.
main.admin.deleting.message: Deleting {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}

main.admin.failed.description: Notification: doing it as administrator failed too. {err} is the reason, e.g. "Not authorized".

main.admin.making.description: What permission refused, before ": permission denied. As administrator, …": a new folder. {name} is its name, e.g. "Backup".

main.admin.offer.description: Text of the Permission denied dialog. {what} is what was refused, e.g. 'Making "Backup"' or 'Renaming to "notes.txt"'.
main.admin.offer.message: {what}: permission denied. As administrator, the system asks for the password.

main.admin.offer_delete.description: Text of the Permission denied dialog for a deletion (no trash then). {what} is what was refused, e.g. "Deleting 3 items".
main.admin.offer_delete.message: {what}: permission denied. As administrator, the system asks for the password. What is deleted so is gone for good.

main.admin.title.description: Title of the dialog offering to do something as administrator after the system refused it.

main.delete.from_archive.description: Delete dialog inside an archive (no trash there). {archive} is the archive's name, e.g. "backup.zip". kind is "folder" or "file" for one chosen entry, its name in {name} (e.g. "Photos"); "other" for several, {count} of them (e.g. 3).
main.delete.from_archive.message: {kind, select, folder {Delete the folder "{name}" from {archive}? This cannot be undone.} file {Delete the file "{name}" from {archive}? This cannot be undone.} other {Delete {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} from {archive}? This cannot be undone.}}

main.delete.on_server.description: Delete dialog on a server (no trash there). {server} is its address, e.g. "sftp://me@nas". kind is "folder" or "file" for one chosen entry, its name in {name} (e.g. "Photos"); "other" for several, {count} of them (e.g. 3).
main.delete.on_server.message: {kind, select, folder {Delete the folder "{name}" on {server}? This cannot be undone.} file {Delete the file "{name}" on {server}? This cannot be undone.} other {Delete {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} on {server}? This cannot be undone.}}

main.delete.permanently.description: Delete permanently dialog: deleted without the trash. kind is "folder" or "file" for one chosen entry, its name in {name} (e.g. "Photos"); "other" for several, {count} of them (e.g. 3).
main.delete.permanently.message: {kind, select, folder {Delete the folder "{name}" permanently? This cannot be undone.} file {Delete the file "{name}" permanently? This cannot be undone.} other {Delete {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} permanently? This cannot be undone.}}

main.delete.title.description: Title and confirming button of the dialog asking whether to delete. Keep it short.

main.delete.title_permanently.description: Title and confirming button of the dialog asking whether to delete without the trash (Shift+Delete). Keep it short.

main.delete.to_trash.description: Delete dialog: the chosen entries go to the trash. kind is "folder" or "file" for one chosen entry, its name in {name} (e.g. "Photos"); "other" for several, {count} of them (e.g. 3).
main.delete.to_trash.message: {kind, select, folder {Move the folder "{name}" to the trash?} file {Move the file "{name}" to the trash?} other {Move {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} to the trash?}}

main.download.edit.description: A task in the operations queue: a server's file is downloaded to open it in the editor. {file} is its name, e.g. "notes.txt".

main.download.view.description: A task in the operations queue: a server's file is downloaded to show it in the viewer. {file} is its name, e.g. "report.pdf".

main.error.make_folder.description: Notification: a new folder (F7) could not be made. {err} is the reason, e.g. "Photos exists already".

main.error.read_settings.description: Notification at start: the settings file could not be read, so the defaults are used. {err} is the reason.

main.error.read_tabs.description: Notification at start: the tabs open last time could not be read. {err} is the reason.
main.error.read_tabs.message: Could not read the open tabs: {err}

main.error.read_workspaces.description: Notification at start: the saved workspaces (named sets of tabs) could not be read. {err} is the reason.

main.error.save_settings.description: Notification: the settings file could not be written. {err} is the reason, e.g. "No space left on device".

main.folder_tree.home.description: Sidebar › Folders: the tree's first root, the user's home folder. Keep it short.

main.go.no_such_folder.description: Notification: a path typed in a server's path bar without the server's address is no folder here either. {path} is it, e.g. "/srv/www".
main.go.no_such_folder.message: {path}: no such folder on this computer

main.new_folder.label.description: Label of the field in the New folder dialog; a path such as a/b makes the folders inside too.

main.new_folder.title.description: Title of the dialog asking a new folder's name (F7).

main.sync_browsing.lost.description: Notification: the other panel could not follow, so Synchronized Browsing was turned off. {err} is the reason, e.g. "/data/2024: No such file or directory".

main.tool.needs_file.description: Notification on running a Tools menu item whose command uses the file under the cursor while it is on "..". %N, %O and %E are placeholders in the command: keep them.
main.tool.needs_file.message: The cursor is on no file: %N, %O and %E need one.

main.tool.needs_local_folder.description: Notification on running a Tools menu item whose command uses %T (the other panel's folder). %T is a placeholder in the command: keep it.
main.tool.needs_local_folder.message: The other panel shows a server or an archive: %T needs a folder on this computer.

main.undo.done.description: Notification: an operation was undone (way is "undo") or done again (way is "redo"). {title} is the operation, e.g. 'Rename "a.txt" to "b.txt"'.

main.undo.failed.description: Notification: undoing (way is "undo") or redoing (way is "redo") failed. {title} is the operation, e.g. 'Rename "a.txt" to "b.txt"'; {err} the reason.
main.undo.failed.message: {way, select, redo {Could not redo "{title}": {err}} other {Could not undo "{title}": {err}}}

main.undo.nothing.description: Notification on Ctrl+Z (way is "undo") or Ctrl+Shift+Z (way is "redo") with nothing to undo or redo.
main.undo.nothing.message: {way, select, redo {Nothing to redo.} other {Nothing to undo.}}

main.undo.queued.description: Notification: undoing (way is "undo") or redoing (way is "redo") a move waits in the operations queue. {title} is the operation, e.g. "Move 3 items to /home/me".
main.undo.queued.message: {way, select, redo {In the queue to redo: {title}} other {In the queue to undo: {title}}}

panel.admin.renaming.description: What permission refused, before ": permission denied. As administrator, …": a rename. {name} is the new name, e.g. "notes.txt".

panel.clipboard.copied.description: Notification after Ctrl+C: {count} files or folders are on the clipboard, e.g. 3. Ctrl+V is a key's name.
panel.clipboard.copied.message: {count, plural, one {# item copied} other {# items copied}}: Ctrl+V pastes them.

panel.clipboard.cut.description: Notification after Ctrl+X: {count} files or folders are cut, to be moved, e.g. 3. Ctrl+V is a key's name.
panel.clipboard.cut.message: {count, plural, one {# item cut} other {# items cut}}: Ctrl+V pastes them.

panel.clipboard.no_cut_in_archive.description: Notification on Ctrl+X inside an archive. Ctrl+C is a key's name.
panel.clipboard.no_cut_in_archive.message: Files cannot be cut out of archives; Ctrl+C copies them.

panel.clipboard.no_files.description: Notification on Ctrl+V when nothing copied is a file.

panel.clipboard.no_paste_in_archive.description: Notification on Ctrl+V inside an archive.
panel.clipboard.no_paste_in_archive.message: Files cannot be pasted into archives yet.

panel.clipboard.same_folder.description: Notification on Ctrl+V in the folder the files were copied from. Ctrl+V is a key's name.
panel.clipboard.same_folder.message: They are in this folder already: Ctrl+V pastes into another one.

panel.column.attr.description: Column title over a panel's file list: the attributes or permissions (e.g. rwxr-xr-x). Keep it very short, an abbreviation.

panel.column.date.description: Column title over a panel's file list: the date and time modified. Keep it short.

panel.column.ext.description: Column title over a panel's file list: the file's extension (e.g. txt). Keep it very short, an abbreviation.

panel.column.name.description: Column title over a panel's file list. Keep it short.

panel.column.size.description: Column title over a panel's file list. Keep it short.

panel.disconnect.description: Tooltip of the × button in the path bar of a server, a mounted share or a phone: closes the connection.

panel.drag.items.description: Beside the mouse pointer while dragging several files: {count} is how many, e.g. 3.

panel.error.archive_not_updatable.description: Error: this kind of archive cannot be changed (only 7z, zip and tar can). {name} is the archive's name, e.g. "photos.rar". 7-Zip is a program's name.
panel.error.archive_not_updatable.message: {name}: 7-Zip changes 7z, zip and tar archives in place, not this one

panel.error.archive_on_server.description: Error: files inside an archive on a server cannot be deleted, renamed or added. {name} is the archive's name, e.g. "backup.zip".
panel.error.archive_on_server.message: {name}: archives on servers cannot be changed yet

panel.error.branch_view_local.description: Error: Branch View (all files under a folder in one list) does not work on a server or in an archive. "Branch View" is the command's name in the Commands menu.
panel.error.branch_view_local.message: Branch View lists this computer's folders

panel.error.exists.description: Error making or renaming a file or folder: {name} is the name wanted, e.g. "Photos".

panel.error.folder_in_the_way.description: Error copying a file over another: a folder has the file's name there. Lowercase, as it follows a colon.
panel.error.folder_in_the_way.message: a folder of this name is in the way

panel.error.inside_archive.description: Error after "Could not …:": this cannot be done inside an archive yet. Lowercase, as it follows a colon.

panel.error.make_file.description: Notification: a new text file (Shift+F4) could not be made. {err} is the reason, e.g. "notes.txt exists already".

panel.error.no_name.description: Error after "Could not make the folder:": the name typed was empty. Lowercase, as it follows a colon.

panel.error.not_a_name.description: Error making or renaming a file: what was typed holds a slash or is "." or "..". {name} is what was typed, e.g. "a/b".

panel.error.other_drive.description: Error when Synchronized Browsing cannot follow: the other panel moved to another drive. Lowercase, as it follows a colon.
panel.error.other_drive.message: the other panel went to another drive

panel.error.rename.description: Notification: renaming a file failed. {err} is the system's reason, e.g. "Permission denied".

panel.filter.custom.label.description: Label of the field in the Show files dialog. *.txt *.md are file masks and | the character between shown and left-out ones: keep them.
panel.filter.custom.label.message: File types, e.g. *.txt *.md (after |, those left out):

panel.filter.custom.title.description: Title of the dialog asking which file types the panel shows (Show › Custom…).

panel.filter.programs.description: Path bar, in brackets after the folder: the panel shows only programs (Show › Programs), as "/home/me  (programs)". Lowercase, short.

panel.filter.selected_files.description: Path bar, in brackets after the folder: the panel shows only the files selected before (Show › Only Selected Files), as "/home/me  (selected files)". Lowercase, short.

panel.found.branch_view.description: Path bar, bold before the folder: Branch View is on, every file under the folder in one list. Keep it short.

panel.found.search_results.description: Path bar, bold before the folder: the panel lists the files a search found. Keep it short.

panel.new_text_file.label.description: Label of the field in the New text file dialog.
panel.new_text_file.label.message: File name, opened in the editor:

panel.new_text_file.title.description: Title of the dialog asking a new text file's name (Shift+F4).

panel.opening.cancel.description: Button stopping the opening of an archive. Keep it short.

panel.opening.reading.description: Opening archive dialog, beside the progress bar while no percentage is known. Keep it short.

panel.opening.title.description: Title of the dialog shown while a large archive is listed or downloaded.

panel.quick_filter.hint.description: Hint in the empty quick filter field under a panel. Escape is the key's name. Lowercase, short.
panel.quick_filter.hint.message: hides what does not match; Escape shows all

panel.quick_filter.label.description: Label under a panel while letters typed hide the files that do not match (quick filter). Keep it short.

panel.quick_search.label.description: Label under a panel while letters typed find a file by its name, as Total Commander's quick search. Keep it short.

panel.size.app.description: Size column of a macOS application bundle, in place of a size, as Total Commander's <DIR>. Keep it short; the angle brackets may stay.

panel.size.b.description: A size in bytes, under 1 KB: {size} is the number, e.g. 512. Use the language's usual unit symbol.

panel.size.dir.description: Size column of a folder, in place of a size, as Total Commander's <DIR>. Keep it short; the angle brackets may stay.

panel.size.gb.description: A size in gigabytes: {size} is the number with two decimals, e.g. 4.27. Use the language's usual unit symbol.

panel.size.kb.description: A size in kilobytes (1024 bytes): {size} is the number with one decimal, e.g. 1.5. Use the language's usual unit symbol.

panel.size.mb.description: A size in megabytes: {size} is the number with one decimal, e.g. 12.3. Use the language's usual unit symbol.

panel.size.tb.description: A size in terabytes: {size} is the number with two decimals, e.g. 1.82. Use the language's usual unit symbol.

panel.space.bytes.description: Calculate occupied space dialog: the total size. {count} chooses the form; {size} is the same number grouped, e.g. "1 234 567"; {human} is it rounded, e.g. "1.2 MB".

panel.space.close.description: Button closing the Calculate occupied space dialog. Keep it short.

panel.space.counting.description: Calculate occupied space dialog: still counting.

panel.space.done.description: Calculate occupied space dialog: counting is over.

panel.space.files.description: Calculate occupied space dialog: label before the number of files. Keep it short.

panel.space.folders.description: Calculate occupied space dialog: label before the number of folders. Keep it short.

panel.space.in_archive.description: Notification: folder sizes are not counted inside an archive. "Size" is the column's title (panel.column.size).
panel.space.in_archive.message: Inside archives the Size column has the sizes already.

panel.space.title.description: Title of the dialog counting the selected files' and folders' size (Ctrl+L).

panel.space.total.description: Calculate occupied space dialog: label before the size. Keep it short.

panel.space.unreadable.description: Calculate occupied space dialog: {count} files or folders were not counted, e.g. 2.
panel.space.unreadable.message: {count, plural, one {# item could not be read.} other {# items could not be read.}}

panel.status.description: Status line under a panel, as Total Commander's: selected / all. {marked_size} and {size} are kilobytes (e.g. "1 234"), {marked_files} / {files} the selected and all files, {marked_folders} / {folders} the selected and all folders. "k" is kilobytes; keep it short.
panel.status.message: {marked_size} k / {size} k in {marked_files} / {files, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}, {marked_folders} / {folders, plural, one {# dir} other {# dirs}}

panel.sync_browsing.stop.description: Tooltip of the link button in the path bar while Synchronized Browsing is on (both panels move together). "Synchronized Browsing" is the command's name in the Commands menu.

panel.undo.rename.description: What Undo (Ctrl+Z) undoes, shown as "Undone: …": a rename. {name} is the old name, {to} the new one, e.g. "a.txt" and "b.txt".

quick_open.go_to.description: Quick Open's row for a path or address typed: {path} is what was typed, e.g. "~/Documents" or "sftp://nas".

quick_open.group.bookmarks.description: Quick Open: heading over the bookmarked folders. Keep it short.

quick_open.group.connections.description: Quick Open: heading over the saved servers (SFTP, FTP, WebDAV, …). Keep it short.

quick_open.group.drives.description: Quick Open: heading over the drives and devices. Keep it short.

quick_open.group.path.description: Quick Open: heading over the row for the path typed. Keep it short.

quick_open.group.recent_folders.description: Quick Open: heading over the folders the tab was in lately. Keep it short.

quick_open.group.tools.description: Quick Open: heading over the user's own commands of the Tools menu. Keep it short.

quick_open.group.workspaces.description: Quick Open: heading over the workspaces (named sets of tabs). Keep it short.

quick_open.placeholder.description: Placeholder in Quick Open's empty field.
quick_open.placeholder.message: A command, bookmark, folder, path, server, drive, workspace or tool

quick_open.title.description: Title of the Quick Open box (Go › Quick Open), where one types to find a command, folder, server or tool.

tabs.error.reopen.description: Notification: a closed tab could not be opened again. {err} is the reason, e.g. "No such file or directory".

tabs.history.empty.description: Notification on Alt+Down (the tab's folder history) when the tab has been nowhere else yet.
tabs.history.empty.message: No folders in this tab's history yet.

tabs.new.description: Tooltip of the + button after a panel's folder tabs.

tabs.rename.label.description: Label of the field in the Rename tab dialog.

tabs.rename.title.description: Title of the dialog giving a folder tab its own name.

tabs.search_results.description: A folder tab's title while it lists the files a search found. Keep it short.

toolbar.customize.description: Item of the toolbar's right-click menu: opens Settings › Toolbar. "…" means a dialog opens.

workspaces.button.close.description: Workspaces dialog button. Keep it short.

workspaces.button.delete.description: Workspaces dialog button. "..." means a dialog opens. Keep it short.

workspaces.button.duplicate.description: Workspaces dialog button: a copy of the selected workspace. "..." means a dialog opens. Keep it short.

workspaces.button.new.description: Workspaces dialog button. "..." means a dialog opens. Keep it short.

workspaces.button.rename.description: Workspaces dialog button. "..." means a dialog opens. Keep it short.

workspaces.delete.button.description: Confirming button of the Delete Workspace dialog. Keep it short.

workspaces.delete.closed.description: Delete Workspace dialog, for a workspace not in use. {name} is its name, e.g. "Photos".
workspaces.delete.closed.message: Delete the workspace "{name}"? Its tabs are forgotten.

workspaces.delete.closed_shells.description: Delete Workspace dialog, for a workspace not in use whose terminal tabs still run. {name} is its name, e.g. "Photos".
workspaces.delete.closed_shells.message: Delete the workspace "{name}"? Its tabs are forgotten, and the shells in its terminal tabs end.

workspaces.delete.open.description: Delete Workspace dialog, for the workspace in use. {name} is its name, {other} the one opened in its place, e.g. "Photos" and "Default".
workspaces.delete.open.message: Delete the workspace "{name}"? Its tabs close; "{other}" opens instead.

workspaces.delete.open_shells.description: Delete Workspace dialog, for the workspace in use with terminal tabs. {name} is its name, {other} the one opened in its place, e.g. "Photos" and "Default".
workspaces.delete.open_shells.message: Delete the workspace "{name}"? Its tabs close, and the shells in its terminal tabs end; "{other}" opens instead.

workspaces.delete.title.description: Title of the dialog asking whether to delete a workspace.

workspaces.duplicate.name.description: A workspace copy's proposed name: {name} is the original's, e.g. "Photos".

workspaces.duplicate.title.description: Title of the dialog asking the name of a workspace's copy.

workspaces.error.name_taken.description: Notification: the name typed for a workspace is another one's.

workspaces.error.no_name.description: Notification: the name typed for a workspace was empty.

workspaces.error.save.description: Notification: the workspaces file could not be written. {err} is the reason, e.g. "No space left on device".

workspaces.hint.description: Workspaces dialog, over the list. "Show > Workspaces" is a menu path: use the menus' own words.
workspaces.hint.message: Show > Workspaces opens one. What changes in the open one is kept in it.

workspaces.name.label.description: Label of the name field in the New, Duplicate and Rename Workspace dialogs.

workspaces.new.name.description: A new workspace's proposed name: {number} is the first free number, e.g. 2.

workspaces.new.title.description: Title of the dialog asking a new workspace's name.

workspaces.open.description: Workspaces dialog: after the name of the workspace in use. Lowercase, short.

workspaces.rename.title.description: Title of the dialog asking a workspace's new name.

workspaces.summary.panels.description: Workspaces dialog, under a workspace's name: how many tabs each panel has, e.g. 2 and 1.
workspaces.summary.panels.message: Left {left, plural, one {# tab} other {# tabs}}, right {right, plural, one {# tab} other {# tabs}}

workspaces.summary.terminal.description: Workspaces dialog, under a workspace's name: how many tabs each panel and the terminal have, e.g. 2, 1 and 3.
workspaces.summary.terminal.message: Left {left, plural, one {# tab} other {# tabs}}, right {right, plural, one {# tab} other {# tabs}}, terminal {terminal, plural, one {# tab} other {# tabs}}

workspaces.summary.terminal_hidden.description: Workspaces dialog, under a workspace's name: how many tabs each panel and the hidden terminal have, e.g. 2, 1 and 3.
workspaces.summary.terminal_hidden.message: Left {left, plural, one {# tab} other {# tabs}}, right {right, plural, one {# tab} other {# tabs}}, terminal {terminal, plural, one {# tab} other {# tabs}} (hidden)

workspaces.title.description: Title of the dialog listing the workspaces: named sets of both panels' tabs and the terminal's.
